content: To whom did the elder write 3 John?
explanation: He loved him in the truth. “The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth” (3 John 1:1, BSB)

content: In 3 John, what is the elder's greatest joy?
explanation: Faithfulness brings joy. “I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.” (3 John 1:4, BSB)

content: In 3 John, the elder says do not imitate evil, but imitate what?
explanation: The one who does good is of God. “Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good.” (3 John 1:11, BSB)

content: In 3 John, what does the elder pray Gaius will enjoy?
explanation: As his soul prospers. “I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.” (3 John 1:2, BSB)

content: In 3 John, who loved to be first and would not accept the elder?
explanation: He rejected the elder's instruction. “but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.” (3 John 1:9, BSB)

content: In 3 John, who received a good testimony from everyone?
explanation: Even the truth spoke for him. “Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself.” (3 John 1:12, BSB)
